pages.name: Queen's Gambit Accepted: Old Variation, Korchnoi Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 1 developed a bishop already on c4 to e2/d3; plan 3 used an open e-file and Re1 that do not exist with the king on f1. Rewrote both (regain d4 now that exd4 is legal, untangle the king); British spelling.

pages.name: Queen's Gambit Accepted: Old Variation, Novikov Gambit
pages.notes: Plan 2 put the bishop on e7 where the queen stands; plan 3 routed a knight f1-e3 loosely. Rewrote plans 1-3 (Ngf3, Nxd4; the e3-pawn is pinned so exd4 is illegal); British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: 3.Nf3 c5 4.d5 e6 5.Nc3 exd5 6.Qxd5 Qxd5 7.Nxd5
pages.notes: Plans named a c7-pawn; Black's c-pawn is on c5 and c7 is the fork square. Rewrote both plans around Nc7+ and covering c7.

pages.name: QGA: 3.Nf3 c5 4.d5 e6 5.Nc3 exd5 6.Qxd5 Qxd5 7.Nxd5 Bd6
pages.notes: Plan 1 pressed a c7-pawn that is not there; rewrote it around regaining c4. British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: QGA: 3.Nf3 c5 4.d5 e6 5.Nc3 exd5 6.Qxd5 Qxd5 7.Nxd5 Bd6 8.Nd2
pages.notes: Overview gave White a d5-pawn (it is a knight); plan 1 routed Nd2-b3-c4 into Black's pawn; plan 2 put two pieces on e7; plan 4 spoke of a c-file. Rewrote overview sentence and plans 1, 2 and 4.

pages.name: QGA: 3.Nf3 c5 4.e3
pages.notes: Plan 2 wrote ...Nd5 for a knight two moves away; reworded. British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: 3.Nf3 c5 4.e3 cxd4 5.Bxc4
pages.notes: Plan 1 called d5 White's outpost and pushed d4-d5 with Black's pawn on d4; rewrote it (recapture on d4, e5 outpost). British spelling.

pages.name: QGA: 3.Nf3 e6 4.e3
pages.notes: Plan 3 pressed a d5-pawn Black does not have; rewrote it. British spelling elsewhere.

pages.name: QGA: 3.Nf3 e6 4.Qa4+
pages.notes: Plan 1 regained c4 slowly with e3 and Bxc4 instead of Qxc4; rewrote it.

pages.name: QGA: Seirawan Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 gave White a d5-pawn (it is a knight); plan 1 ignored the attack on d5. Rewrote overview sentence and plans 1, 2 and 4.
